summary: Frontend-only e2e of the redesigned /developers Developer Portal. Verified the full interactive 3-step proof lifecycle (sandbox key -> generate proof -> verify), snippet pre-fill into Quick Start + SDK examples, SDK tab switching, 5-card live platform status, onboarding scroll, and 'Proof Artifact' terminology. All functional flows pass against the live backend; one minor data-testid gap found on CodeBlock containers.

testability_gaps.issue: CodeBlock applies the testid prop ONLY to the inner copy button (data-testid="copy-<testid>"), not to the container or the <pre>/<code>. So review-specified selectors data-testid="first-proof-request", "first-proof-response", and "sdk-example-python|javascript|java|dotnet" are NOT directly queryable. They only exist as copy-first-proof-request, copy-first-proof-response, copy-sdk-example-<lang>. Functionally correct (request/response are rendered and SDK code switches), but the explicit testids in the spec are missing.
testability_gaps.suggested_fix: Add data-testid={testid} to the outer wrapper div in CodeBlock so both the container and the copy button are addressable (or expose a separate containerTestid prop).

verified_flows: GET /developers renders developers-page, dev-onboarding, dev-playground, dev-sdks, dev-platform-status
Terminology: 'Financial Evidence Artifact' NOT present; 'Proof Artifact' used in visible copy
generate-sandbox-key-btn -> POST /api/demo/sandbox-key -> sandbox-key-result rendered; sandbox-key-value = pfp_sandbox_468d36fc... (starts with pfp_sandbox_)
generate-proof-btn DISABLED before key, ENABLED after key (first-proof-need-key hint shown initially)
generate-proof-btn -> POST /api/fea/generate (X-API-Key header) -> first-proof-result rendered with proof-id-value, proof-timestamp-value, proof-hash-value, proof-signature-value all populated
verify-proof-input auto-fills with proof ID from Step 2 (matched exactly)
verify-proof-btn -> GET /api/public/verify/{id} -> verify-outcome shows 'Proof is authentic & untampered'; check-signature, check-hash, check-timestamp all PASS
Quick Start step-credentials and step-generate snippets contain the actual generated sandbox key (pre-fill working)
Sdks section contains the actual sandbox key (pre-fill working in current SDK example)
sdk-tab-python, sdk-tab-javascript, sdk-tab-java, sdk-tab-dotnet all switch the rendered example (copy-sdk-example-<lang> updates accordingly)
PlatformStatus: status-api, status-docs, status-sdks, status-verification, status-demo all resolve to 'Operational' (live /api/health + /api/openapi.json driven)
onboarding-step-1..5 present; clicking onboarding-step-4 smooth-scrolls #sdks into view; onboarding-step-5 scrolls #resources into view
action_items: (Optional/LOW) In CodeBlock.jsx, propagate the testid prop onto the outer wrapper div so the explicit selectors first-proof-request, first-proof-response, sdk-example-python|javascript|java|dotnet listed in the spec are directly queryable. The data IS rendered today — only the testids on the container are missing.
critical_code_review_comments: CodeBlock testid is only attached to the copy button; the spec advertises container testids (first-proof-request, first-proof-response, sdk-example-<lang>) that don't exist on the DOM container. Low-impact but breaks direct selector access for QA/automation.
SandboxContext silently swallows clipboard write errors in CopyInline/CodeBlock (try/catch with empty body). Consider surfacing copy failures or at least logging.
FirstProof relies on response shape resp.fea_payload?.fea_hash; if backend ever flattens this, the Hash field renders blank silently. Add a fallback / explicit empty-state warning.
PlatformStatus treats 'verification' and 'demo' as health-driven (same /api/health check as 'api'); they will all flip together. Consider per-component probes if independent uptime is desired.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 12 spec items pass; 1 minor testability gap)

test_credentials: Not required — Developer Portal is public.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full interactive lifecycle (key -> proof -> verify) works against live backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Sandbox key generated example: pfp_sandbox_468d36fc8b62bc94cce7d1d9396a090265e27113. Note CodeBlock only exposes copy-<testid> on the copy button; to assert container content, query the parent (e.g. data-testid='step-credentials' for Quick Start snippets, or [data-testid='dev-sdks'] inner text for SDK examples). Verify outcome string is 'Proof is authentic & untampered'.
